note: Weekly syllabus shown on /syllabus. Edit the weeks below to update the site; no code changes needed. `week` is the week number (used as the row id, so keep it unique). `sprint` colour-codes the row with a left-edge stripe and must be an `id` from `sprints` below, or null for weeks outside a sprint. The table renders two columns: `mle` (the Technical column) and `accelerator` (the venture-building strand, often led by a guest). `mle` keeps the outline's own format: a list of `sections`, each with a `heading` and `bullets`, where a bullet is a string or an object with `text` and nested `children`. Use an empty `sections` list for a week with no outline content. `accelerator` has a `topic` (short title), a `detail` (a sentence), `people` (a list of ids from data/people.json, shown as chips with a hover profile; empty for sessions with no named guest), and `materials`: a list of links where `label` is the link text and `href` is a URL or a path under public/ (e.g. "/slides/week-1.pdf"). Leave `materials` empty ([]) for anything not published yet. Each week still carries a `technical` field, the old 'Engineering' column that was merged into `mle` with the syllabus builder; it is no longer rendered and can be pruned once the merge is trusted.
